so.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders. The medallion disc is now dark lavender purple instead of red. Her face and pose: frightened wide eyes with tiny pupils peeking over a purple flowered quilt pulled up to her nose with both hands, trembling, small blue shiver lines. Clear readable action: both hands clearly gripping the quilt, exactly two hands, arms kept inside the medallion. Both eyes looking together. Everything kept INSIDE the round medallion, the medallion drawn a bit smaller and centred so there is empty space around it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background outside the medallion, nothing else, no text.
so.B: Same young consort, same soft hand-painted storybook style, same elegant black bun with two gold hairpins, small pearl ornament and small pink flower, same jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with ivory (#F1E6D2) collar, same round gold-rimmed dark lavender purple medallion as the reference. NEW: she is SCARED AND HIDING and leans OUT of the round medallion toward the viewer: her head and shoulders come forward over the gold rim, her hands overlap the gold ring; a clear readable action, no big arms, arms stay inside the picture, exactly two hands, no extra hands; both hands gripping a purple flowered silk quilt pulled up to her nose over the gold rim like a curtain, only her wide scared eyes and forehead above it, trembling; small blue shiver lines. Wide jade green sleeves visible. Both eyes looking together. The medallion stays round and centred, a bit smaller, with her popping slightly out of it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background, nothing else, no text.
so.out: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green the whole time. The young consort with the gold hairpins inside the round gold medallion takes a fright: she jolts forward over the gold rim and yanks a purple flowered quilt up to her nose with both hands, her eyes go wide, small blue shiver lines appear; she comes out of the round frame toward the viewer. Clear readable action, exactly two hands, arms stay inside the picture, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Smooth, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
so.loop: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green. The young consort with the gold hairpins leaning out of the round gold medallion keeps hiding in fear in a loop: she trembles behind the quilt, her wide eyes dart left and right together, she pulls the quilt a little higher, the shiver lines flicker; then she settles back to exactly the starting pose. Clear readable action, exactly two hands, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Slow enough to read, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
